TASK: Implement the native rorca contract in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. This is an executable assignment, not a context handoff.

DELIVERABLE: Working uncommitted native code plus RED and GREEN evidence for rorca identity, Ghostty preference import, safe project registration, and branch-list IPC. Return exact test commands/results, touched files, and residual limitations.

SCOPE: You exclusively own src-tauri/**. Do not modify ui/**, docs, .omo/**, or generated image source. Existing generated icons in src-tauri/icons are already present; you may wire Tauri config to them. Do not commit, stash, reset, checkout, or revert other work.

READ FIRST: .omo/plans/rorca-ui-parity.md, ORCA_LITE_PARITY_AUDIT.md, ORCA_LITE_PARITY_FIX_EXECUTION.md, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, the existing IPC/worktree/terminal modules and integration tests.

REQUIREMENTS:
1. Native identity: change product/window identity to rorca (not legacy Orca Lite) and use the generated icons. Preserve package/bundle compatibility only where required; report any identifier decision with rationale.
2. Ghostty contract (TDD): create focused tests FIRST that fail for (a) repeated font-family is last-wins; observed config has MesloLGS NF then Noto Sans KR, so Noto Sans KR is effective, (b) macos-option-as-alt=true is parsed, (c) absent/malformed config returns safe defaults. Implement a typed, non-executing parser for this supported subset. Expose a camelCase terminal-preferences DTO/IPC command for the UI. Config lookup may use standard Ghostty macOS locations, but must be deterministic and independently testable from an injected path/string.
3. Project add/branch selector contract (TDD): the UI needs a safe typed command to register/add a local Git project into WorkspaceRegistry by canonicalizing its repo root and a typed command returning real local branches for the selected workspace. Validate paths/allowed roots using the existing IPC security patterns; never trust raw paths for Git operations. Add integration coverage for valid repo, invalid/non-git path, and branch list.
4. Preserve every completed D1-D11 terminal/worktree safety invariant and camelCase structured errors.

VERIFY: Capture each RED before the corresponding production implementation, then GREEN using cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Run cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings after all native changes. Use LSP diagnostics on changed Rust files. Do not suppress any warning/error.

STOP WHEN: All four native requirements are implemented with RED->GREEN evidence, Rust tests+clippy pass, LSP errors are absent, and your summary names the exact UI IPC contract the frontend lane must consume.

nodes.task_summary: Implement rorca identity, Ghostty prefs, project/branch IPC with TDD

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the full exclusive frontend rorca parity lane in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite after native-contract and visual-reference are complete. This is an executable assignment, not a context handoff.

DELIVERABLE: Uncommitted working ui/** code, test-first RED->GREEN evidence for every behavior, full bun tests/build green, visual/reference conformance summary, and an exact touched-file list.

SCOPE: You exclusively own ui/**. You may read the native contract and .omo evidence but NEVER edit src-tauri/**, .omo/**, ORCA_*.md, or generated native icons. Do not commit, stash, reset, checkout, or revert other work.

READ FIRST: .omo/plans/rorca-ui-parity.md; .omo/evidence/rorca/visual-reference.md; native-contract's code; ORCA_LITE_PARITY_AUDIT.md; ORCA_LITE_PARITY_FIX_EXECUTION.md; current App/Sidebar/WorkspaceHeader/TerminalSplitView/SettingsDialog/CommandPalette/WorktreeList/terminal settings/shortcuts/store components and tests.

IMPLEMENT, WITH A FAITHFUL RED TEST BEFORE EACH PRODUCTION INCREMENT:
1. Identity/assets: ui/index.html title becomes rorca and serves ui/src/assets/rorca-icon.svg as favicon. Keep the existing rorca-icon test green; add a machine-consumed index/title/fav icon test if a seam exists.
2. Compact original-Orca shell: rebuild CSS/layout from visual-reference. 1280x850 target: narrow charcoal project rail; compact nav/search/projects list; low-chrome tabs; quiet canvas; correct separators/spacing/type. Remove card-heavy/modal-slop styling.
3. Terminal controls/shortcuts: Move split orientation/menu controls into each terminal pane header; remove global WorkspaceHeader split and global Interrupt terminal button. Keep raw terminal input unblocked. Ensure shortcut routing happens in capture phase only for registered modifier chords: new tab, close, next/previous, horizontal split, vertical split, unsplit, command palette. Registered chords prevent default only when matched; ordinary xterm typing and Ctrl-C must pass through. Write tests for terminal-target guard and every action dispatch, including a controlled failing assertion for the current global ownership.
4. Functional project/workspace/tab flow: wire Add Project to the new native contract, wire Add Worktree to a branch dropdown/combobox populated from native branch list (no text branch input), and make Workspace focus rail / Search open palette / visible tab controls perform state transitions. Use structured errors, no direct invoke outside lib/tauri.ts. Test each flow before implementation.
5. Original-Orca-like Settings: replace modal stack with compact left nav/right detail panel. Real in-scope sections only: General/Appearance, Terminal, Keyboard Shortcuts, Workspace. Read terminal preferences from the native Ghostty command on startup; show source/effective values; apply effective font family and option-as-alt behavior to xterm; local rorca setting override wins. Tests must fail on the old default-only modal then prove imported values reach terminal options.
6. Native titlebar interaction: use a real drag region only on background; mark all buttons/inputs/splitters terminal controls no-drag. Preserve sidebar resize and test drag-region classification. Do not implement a fake CSS-only drag surface.
7. Preserve D1 mirror-split and one-writer semantics; do not add a second same-worktree PTY.

VERIFY after each increment: targeted tests; after all changes run bun run --cwd ui test and bun run --cwd ui build; run LSP diagnostics on every changed TS/TSX/CSS file. No skipped/only tests and no suppression.

VISUAL QA: Start from visual-reference target. Capture implementation screenshots through the real dev app only if safe; otherwise provide a file:line visual checklist for final verifier. Do not claim pixel equivalence without screenshots.

STOP WHEN: All seven requirements have RED->GREEN evidence, full frontend gates are green, LSP diagnostics clean, and final summary includes test counts, remaining runtime-only proof, and UI actions ready for the desktop verifier.

TASK: Run the complete read-only verification gates after the rorca implementation lanes finish.

DELIVERABLE: Write /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/.omo/evidence/rorca/gates.md with exact commands, exit codes, pass counts, relevant warnings/output, current git status, and LSP diagnostics result. Return a concise PASS/FAIL summary.

STOP WHEN: gates.md is complete and your final summary states PASS only if every command exits 0 and diagnostics have no errors.
